name: spires-standoff-anchor
note: THE DELIVERED ARRIVAL. Whatever the jump menu resolves for Rock Spires, pinned at its own composed pose, under the variety tour's conditions (day 0.32, lamp on below 150 m, HUD off). Nothing is hard-coded: this is the only frame in this list that is evidence about the shipped resolver, and the other five are candidate sites the search reaches or nearly reaches.
setup: subwave.worldClock.setDayFraction(0.32); subwave.hud.visible=false; for (const id of ['controls','lock-hint','jump-toast','jump-menu','boot']) { const el=document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.style.display='none'; } subwave.jumpTo('spires'); const p=subwave.player, c=subwave.renderer.camera; const X=p.position[0], Y=p.position[1], Z=p.position[2], YAW=p.yaw, PIT=p.pitch; window.__pin=(window.__pin||0)+1; const tok=window.__pin; (function s(){ if(window.__pin!==tok) return; p.inVessel=false; p.position[0]=X; p.position[1]=Y; p.position[2]=Z; p.prevPosition.set(p.position); p.velocity.fill(0); p.oxygen=p.oxygenCapacity; p.health=100; p.yaw=YAW; p.pitch=PIT; c.setEuler(YAW,PIT,0); p.lampOn=Math.max(0,-p.position[1])>150; requestAnimationFrame(s); })();

name: spires-standoff-ref-1780
note: THE CONTROL, and the frame the whole item is aimed at: the previous pass's measured needle site (1780, 1048) at yaw 0, pitch 0.1955. `needleAim` reproduces this pose exactly - it scores this heading 0.783 and derives pitch 0.195 from a 41.2 deg crest - which is what says the search is asking the right question. The site itself is 4 m off the 8 m refine lattice and so is not reachable.
